title: Security hardening before 24/7 exposure: proxy login-throttle address, steward-write role checks, pilot passwords
acceptance_criteria: The web proxy overwrites X-Forwarded-For with the socket address it saw, so the per-address login throttle cannot be dodged (N-0037 residual)
CST steward bulk preview/apply/ignore and other steward writes in imports.py require steward or admin; the web hides those controls from other roles (N-0038 residual)
Placeholder pilot passwords are rotated or retired by the N-0075 invite flow (BACKLOG-205)
Tests green on touched areas, tsc exit 0, eslint clean on changed files
